num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the directed road network.
depot: <int> Node index where the hauler's tour must start and end.
num_arcs: <int> Total number of directed arcs in the road network.
num_profitable_arcs: <int> Number of arcs that yield a profit when served.
num_VI_nodes: <int> Number of starting nodes that appear in the incompatibility graph.
num_strong_incompatibilities: <int> Number of strong incompatibility edges between starting nodes.
num_weak_incompatibilities: <int> Number of weak incompatibility edges between starting nodes.
arcs: <list[list[int]], shape [num_arcs][3]> Each entry [i, j, cost] defines a directed arc from node i to node j with its traveling cost.
profitable_arcs: <list[list[int]], shape [num_profitable_arcs][3]> Each entry [i, j, profit] defines a profitable arc from node i to node j with its collectible profit.
VI_nodes: <list[int], length num_VI_nodes> Nodes that are starting nodes of profitable arcs and appear in the incompatibility graph.
strong_incompatibilities: <list[list[int]], shape [num_strong_incompatibilities][2]> Each entry [i, j] defines a pair of starting nodes that cannot both have their profitable arcs served.
weak_incompatibilities: <list[list[int]], shape [num_weak_incompatibilities][3]> Each entry [i, j, penalty] defines a pair of starting nodes that can both have their profitable arcs served only if the associated penalty cost is paid.
